plan.angle: The top 10 is help docs and explainers on slider questions (what a slider is, its pros and cons, where the handle starts) plus survey-tool feature pages. None shows a finished slider scale survey with its results. This page shows the build and the readout together: the range, step and end labels set by prompt, a handle that waits to be moved so untouched sliders stay blank, scores split by platform, a team average that emails a manager, before-and-after confidence on a phone, and a price slider read as bands, with every score a number in a database the team owns. The FAQ answers what a builder decides before launch: the 5-point alternative, range, start position, the ceiling effect, phones and reading results.
tab_stories: Lindqvale, a photo editing app, asks 520 users to rate its new export screen on a slider of 0 to 100; the dashboard averages 70 overall but splits it by platform, 78 on iOS and 59 on Android.

Pebblecroft Freight sends a weekly 0 to 10 workload slider to every team; when a team's average falls below 5, the app emails that team's manager, and the support team's 4.2 triggered the email this week.
Wrexley Community College asks 64 workshop attendees to rate their confidence on a 1 to 10 slider on their phones before and after a spreadsheet workshop, and the average rises from 3.9 to 7.4.
Dovecote Pantry asks 312 subscribers what they would pay each month for a breakfast add-on on a $0 to $40 slider in $1 steps; the median is $12 and 128 answers fall in the $10 to $15 band.
